name: Cursed Gas Station
storyline:
Cole starts a night shift at an isolated gas station. The station's owner offers him a job and a room to stay in. For Cole, it seems like the opportunity he needs to get his life back on track.

Work the register, fuel cars, restock the shelves, and keep the station clean. Talk to the people who stop by and get to know the station and its surroundings.

As the nights go on, this routine becomes increasingly unsettling. A strange conversation can turn into an argument. Small details you notice around the station begin to make you question what you know about the place. As strange sounds and unexplained events pile up, you start to wonder whether the building where you work and sleep is safe.

Try to make sense of what is happening at the station while carrying on with your work. Each shift leaves you with a new question about the station's past and the people around you.
summary: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.
